agent_data_note: Use the mounted ICSE 2025 artifact at `dataset_candidate/fuzzing-empirical-study/`. Build all 21 paper benchmark targets, install all nine studied fuzzers plus CDFUZZ, and run the full ICSE 2025 evaluation protocol.
benchmark_rules: Compile fuzz targets with AFL llvm-mode (LLVM-13): `export PATH=/usr/lib/llvm-13/bin:$PATH` and `CC=$CDFUZZ_HOME/afl-clang-fast` (build CDFuzz first).
Primary metric: edge coverage via `afl-showmap` unique edge count. Higher is better.

Run the full paper protocol: **21 benchmark programs**, **9 studied fuzzers** (AFL, AFL++, MOpt, FairFuzz, QSYM, MEUZZ, Pangolin, Angora, REDQUEEN) plus **CDFUZZ**, **24 hours per trial**, **5 independent repeats**, LLVM-13 AFL llvm-mode instrumentation.

Build every benchmark in `dataset_paths.json` → `benchmark_programs_paper`; extend `Experiment/build-bench.sh` for programs not covered (re2, jsoncpp, sqlite3, bloaty, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, libxml2).
Generate dictionaries automatically (FuzzingDriver or equivalent LLVM/CodeQL pass); do not use hand-curated token lists for dictionary-mode fuzzers.
The shared mount is read-only. Write build trees, fuzz output dirs, and metrics under `project/` or `results/`.
Install and build every studied fuzzer from upstream repos; parallelize campaigns across available CPU cores.
Report median edge coverage over 5 repeats per (program, fuzzer) cell; include RQ2 constraint-type analysis per the paper.
non_goals: Using fabricated hello-world C files instead of the 21 real-world paper benchmarks
Substituting Demo/jhead-only experiments for the full benchmark suite
Skipping fuzzers or programs to save time without explicit failure documentation
